name: Brainstorm/Ideation
summary: Users submit multiple ideas to an open prompt, which are then AI-grouped by theme and peer-voted on for quality and relevance.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates brainstorm prompts and can cluster/categorize submitted responses by theme and quality. Cannot reliably assess creativity or depth without rubric.

prompt.description: The open-ended brainstorm prompt that learners will generate ideas for.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of ideas each learner can submit (typically 3-5).

votingEnabled.description: Whether peers vote on submitted ideas after entry phase.

aiGrouping.description: Whether AI automatically groups ideas by theme/category before voting.

sampleIdeas.description: Optional inspiration ideas shown to learners to prime the brainstorm.

timeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds for idea submission phase (optional, 60-180s typical).

ux.mobileNotes: Text input field with submit button. Ideas appear as cards in a scrollable feed. Voting interface uses large tap targets (buttons or reactions below each grouped idea).

ageAdaptations.8-10: Simple, concrete prompts (1-3 ideas max). Visual examples or images to inspire. No voting complexity—just ideas and teacher review.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Open-ended prompts (3-5 ideas). AI grouping shown visually. Peer voting with simple criteria (1-2 dimensions). Discussion optional.
ageAdaptations.14-16: Complex prompts with constraints. Full AI clustering with thematic labels. Multi-criteria peer voting (4+ dimensions). Discussion and synthesis of best ideas.
